constraints: Connectome routing remains authoritative for organ selection.
Delay budgeting applies only after a connectome-selected organ raises an explicitly allow-listed exception.
Retry still requires idempotency, justification, and a maximum of three FCA attempts.
FCA total retry delay is bounded to 120 seconds, stricter than FAP's 240-second ceiling.
Each individual delay remains capped at 60 seconds.
When the remaining delay budget is exhausted, FCA fails closed rather than starting another retry.
FAP jitter is intentionally not imported in this capsule; this change imports only the independently bounded cumulative delay budget.
